title: Why you should not use Vercel for RealTime apps!
description: Vercel is the most popular and widely used hosting platform now a days that provide out of the box support for a number of frameworks and technologies like NextJs, Angular, Gatsby, Ember, Vite and a number of other frameworks. You can easily deploy any app with just a few clicks without having to manually handle all the configurations which can be pretty tiresome. Vercel saves us the efforts and time and just provides everything out of the box. But why Vercel is not a good Choice for Real-Time Apps? In this article, I will discuss why Vercel sucks at real time applications and which platforms can you use to deploy your Real-Time Applications.

title: Navigating Common JavaScript Pitfalls: A Developer’s Guide
description: JavaScript is a powerful and versatile programming language that has become the backbone of modern web. While it offers immense possibilities, developers often encounter common pitfalls that can lead to bugs, performance issues, and headaches. In this guide, we will explore some of these common JavaScript pitfalls and provide insights on how to navigate them like a pro.

title: Mastering Modern JavaScript: Tips and Tricks for Efficient Development
description: Welcome to the world of modern JavaScript! In this article, we will dive into some essential tips and tricks that will help you become a more efficient developer. JavaScript has come a long way, evolving into a powerful language that is crucial for front-end development in today’s companies. We will explore various aspects of debugging, writing concise and efficient code, mastering modern loops, and simplifying asynchronous code using async/await. So, let’s get started!
